lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows, with higher spatial density in the anterior region posterior to the gills, transitioning to wider, more grid-like spacing toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a series of anchor nodes, forming a visible checkerboard-like grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three dominant linear features running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges.
